headline: Ukrainian Drone Attack Ignites Fire at Lukoil Refinery in Perm, Russia
summary: A Ukrainian drone strike set fire to Lukoil's oil refinery in the Perm region deep inside Russia on Monday, threatening to exacerbate regional fuel shortages.
why: Lukoil is one of Russia's largest integrated energy producers and oil refiners.

impacts.name: Lukoil
impacts.why: Lukoil's Perm oil refinery facility caught fire following a Ukrainian drone strike.
